questions.prompt: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Iron-rich dust gives Mars its reddish appearance.

questions.prompt: How many sides does a triangle have?
questions.explanation: A triangle has three straight sides.
The Pacific is the largest ocean on Earth.

questions.prompt: What kind of object is the Sun?
questions.explanation: The Sun is the star at the centre of our solar system.

questions.prompt: Counting outward from the Sun, which number is Earth?
questions.explanation: Mercury and Venus come before Earth.

questions.prompt: Which is the largest planet in our solar system?
questions.explanation: Jupiter is bigger than every other planet in our solar system.

questions.prompt: Of the eight planets, which is farthest from the Sun?
questions.explanation: Our eight-planet line-up ends with Neptune, beyond Uranus.

questions.prompt: What makes the Moon look bright to us?
questions.explanation: Its familiar glow is sunlight bouncing off its surface.

questions.prompt: How many hearts does an octopus have?
questions.explanation: Two hearts move blood through the gills; the third supplies the rest of the body.

questions.prompt: Which living land animal is tallest?
questions.explanation: A giraffe’s long legs and neck put its head above other land animals.

questions.prompt: Which living animal is largest by mass?
questions.explanation: Blue whales outweigh every other living animal.

questions.prompt: How many legs does a honeybee have?
questions.explanation: Bees are insects, and insects have six legs.

questions.prompt: Which animal group do penguins belong to?
questions.explanation: Penguins are flightless birds adapted to swimming.
